PARA:
Alternator
A compact, lightweight, high-output, high-efficiency segment conductor type alternator has been adopted.
A segment joining method, in which segment conductors (rectangular copper wire) are inserted and welded, has been adopted for the stator winding method.
A clutch has been provided in the alternator pulley, reducing accessory belt friction to improve fuel economy.
Alternator Specifications
Segment Conductor (SE0)
Rated Output [A] 100
Rated Voltage [V] 12
Regulator Adjusting Voltage [V] (5000r/min,10A,25°C) 12.2~15.3
Output Start Speed [r/min] 1500 or less
Maximum Allowable Speed [r/min] 18000
